task_completion.description: Load the full 24-subunit biological assembly of 1FHA into PyMOL, not just the monomer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: PyMOL viewport showing a spherical nanocage structure rather than a single alpha-helical bundle. The object list should show 24 chains or a 'type: biological assembly' indicator.

task_completion.description: Color the subunits distinctly to highlight the 24-mer architecture.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D model in the viewport displays multiple different colors corresponding to different chains/subunits.

task_completion.description: Measure the inner and outer diameters of the cage using PyMOL measurement tools.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Dashed measurement lines (wizards/distances) visible in the PyMOL viewport spanning the internal cavity and the external width of the cage.

task_completion.description: Identify and likely select/label the two acidic residues (Asp and Glu) at the 3-fold symmetry channels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Selection indicators (pink dots) or labels on specific residues (Asp/Glu) located at the narrowest part of the pore channels in the cage wall.

task_completion.description: Save a publication-quality image of the cage to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal command showing 'png ~/PyMOL_Data/images/ferritin_cage.png' or a file browser showing the image exists at that path.

task_completion.description: Write a report containing the 24-mer confirmation, diameters, and residue names/numbers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or 'cat' command showing the contents of ~/PyMOL_Data/ferritin_analysis_report.txt with all four required data points.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually used PyMOL and didn't just write a report from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the PyMOL GUI active with the 1FHA structure loaded and manipulated.

integrity.description: Check that the diameters in the report match the visual measurements shown in the PyMOL viewport.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numbers visible on the distance labels in PyMOL should correspond to the values written in the text report.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't simply echo the privileged diameter ranges into the report without measuring.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen using the 'Measurement' wizard or 'dist' command in the PyMOL command line.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 1FHA. The biological assembly is a 24-mer nanocage. Expected inner diameter is approximately 70-90 Angstroms. Expected outer diameter is approximately 110-130 Angstroms. The two conserved acidic residues lining the 3-fold channel are Aspartate (Asp/D) and Glutamate (Glu/E); specifically, in 1FHA, these are typically Asp-131 and Glu-134 (though numbering may vary slightly by chain, the residue types must be Asp and Glu).
